Tier.label: Party level
Tier.hint: Traps adapt to the party: trap level, Stealth, DCs, attack and damage follow the GM Core tables. The library describes them for a level 1 party.

Activators.none: None — the area itself triggers it

trap.label: Trap
trap.hint: ID of the trap's region on this scene. The module sets it — when placing the trap or with “Add trigger”.

OnSave.basic: Basic: crit success — none, success — half, failure — full, crit failure — double
OnSave.avoid: Success avoids it: failure — damage and condition, crit failure — worse condition

pit.name: Hidden Pit
pit.text: A plank lid covered in dirt gives way under weight. Anyone who looks can spot it. A falling creature can Grab an Edge (Reflex save); Thievery wedges the lid shut.
pit.flavor: The floor gives way — a black pit opens beneath!

spikedPit.name: Spiked Pit
spikedPit.text: A hidden pit with sharpened stakes at the bottom. The fall hurts twice: the impact and the spikes.
spikedPit.flavor: The floor collapses — spikes glint below!

bearTrap.name: Bear Trap
bearTrap.text: Steel jaws hidden under straw or leaves. A caught creature is immobilized until it Escapes with Athletics or Acrobatics.
bearTrap.flavor: Steel clangs underfoot — the jaws snap shut!

poisonDarts.name: Poison Darts
poisonDarts.text: A pressure plate fires darts from hidden tubes in the walls. The poison keeps burning after a hit. Tiny holes in the masonry give it away.
poisonDarts.flavor: Darts whistle out of the walls!

arrowVolley.name: Arrow Volley
arrowVolley.text: A tripwire looses a volley from arrow slits. Everyone in the area is under fire.
arrowVolley.flavor: A click — arrows rain from the slits!

scythingBlade.name: Scything Blade
scythingBlade.text: A heavy blade swings out of a slot in the ceiling and sweeps just above the floor. Disabling it takes two successes, one per hinge.
scythingBlade.flavor: A huge blade whistles down from above!

fallingNet.name: Falling Net
fallingNet.text: A net hangs under the ceiling and a tripwire near the floor drops it. Those caught are immobilized until they Escape.
fallingNet.flavor: A heavy net drops from the ceiling!

collapsingRoof.name: Collapsing Roof
collapsingRoof.text: The supports are sawn through, and a tripwire brings the ceiling down. Cracks and fresh dust on the floor are the warning.
collapsingRoof.flavor: The ceiling groans — stones rain down!

rollingBoulder.name: Rolling Boulder
rollingBoulder.text: A pressure plate releases a stone ball that thunders through the corridor and knocks everyone down.
rollingBoulder.flavor: A rumble grows — a boulder rolls down the corridor!

fireJet.name: Fire Jet
fireJet.text: Nozzles in the walls spray flaming alchemical oil. Soot around the holes and the smell of oil give it away.
fireJet.flavor: Flame roars out of the walls!

acidSpray.name: Acid Spray
acidSpray.text: A pressurised vessel sprays acid at whoever steps on the plate, and it keeps eating away. The floor around it is pitted with burns.
acidSpray.flavor: A hiss — acid sprays into your face!

poisonGas.name: Poison Gas
poisonGas.text: A plate opens valves and the room fills with caustic gas: poison damage and sickened. The GM may have the door slam shut.
poisonGas.flavor: Greenish smoke creeps out of the cracks!

sleepGas.name: Sleep Gas
sleepGas.text: A sweet-smelling gas puts everyone in the area to sleep. A sleeper wakes when damaged or shaken awake.
sleepGas.flavor: The air turns sweet, eyelids grow heavy…

lightningRune.name: Lightning Rune
lightningRune.text: An invisible sigil on the floor strikes whoever steps on it with lightning. Disable it with Thievery (expert) or dispel the magic.
lightningRune.flavor: A rune flares underfoot — lightning strikes!

frostRune.name: Frost Rune
frostRune.text: A cold sigil coats everyone around in frost and slows them. The floor near it is always a little colder. Arcana disables it.
frostRune.flavor: The rune flares blue and the air rings with frost!

thunderPlate.name: Thunder Plate
thunderPlate.text: A plate with a carved sigil answers a step with a thunderclap that deafens everyone nearby. The boom carries far. Occultism disables it.

witheringSigil.name: Withering Sigil
witheringSigil.text: A dark seal drains life from everyone standing on it and leaves them drained. Religion disables it. Dangerous even for seasoned heroes.
witheringSigil.flavor: Shadows reach out of the sigil and cold bites to the bone!

alarmPlate.name: Alarm Plate
alarmPlate.text: Harmless, but it rings loudly: guards and monsters learn they have guests. The GM gets a notice.
alarmPlate.flavor: Somewhere above, a bell starts ringing!

App.dragHint: Click a trap to configure it, or drag it onto the map to place it there as a hidden region.
App.empty: Nothing found. Try another search or filter.
App.sceneEmpty: No traps on this scene yet. Drag one from the library onto the map.
App.searchSelectedHint: Selected tokens roll Perception against traps within their spot range (usually 10 ft) and in line of sight.
App.triggerHint: Sets the trap off on the selected tokens, or on everyone in the area if none are selected.
App.attempt: Try to disarm with the selected token
App.confirmDelete: Remove the trap “{name}” from the scene?
App.confirmDeleteCustom: Delete your trap “{name}” from My traps?
App.revealAllHint: Reveal every trap on this scene to players
App.hideAllHint: Hide every trap on this scene from players
App.mineEmpty: Traps you configure and save show up here. Open any trap in the library or on the scene, change what you need and press “Save to My traps…” — you’ll be asked to name it.
App.mineHint: Click a trap to configure it, or drag it onto the map. Use the pencil to rename it.
App.ideaHint: Opens a form in your browser
App.addActivatorHint: Give the trap a trigger (up to three). It appears in the trap's area; move it on the map with the ✥ handle.

Hud.reveal: “{name}” is hidden from players. Click to reveal.
Hud.hide: “{name}” is visible to players. Click to hide.
Hud.noticed: “{name}” was spotted by {who}. Players can’t see it yet — click to reveal.
Hud.disarm: Disable “{name}” with the selected token: {skill}, DC {dc}. A critical failure sets it off.
Hud.fire: Set off “{name}” now — on everyone in its area.
Hud.fireManual: “{name}” only fires manually. Click to set it off on everyone in its area.
Hud.move: Move “{name}” — drag. Triggers inside it move along.
Hud.addTrigger: Add a trigger to “{name}” (up to three)
Hud.rotate: Rotate “{name}” 90° — width and height swap, triggers inside turn with it
Hud.playerDisarm: Disable “{name}” with the selected character: {skill}. A critical failure sets it off.

Chat.noTargets: The trap went off, but nobody is in the area.
Chat.disarmFail: {name} fails to disable “{trap}” ({skill}: {total} vs DC {dc} — {degree}). It didn’t go off — try again.
Chat.disarmTriggered: {name} slips up ({skill}: {total} vs DC {dc} — {degree}) — “{trap}” goes off!
Chat.searchNoneGm: {name} searches for traps and finds nothing (Perception {value}).
Chat.rollDamageHint: Roll damage now without waiting for the remaining saves. It’s one roll for everyone.
Chat.disarmProgress: {name} makes progress on “{trap}” ({skill}: {total} vs DC {dc} — {degree}). Successes: {done} of {needed}.

Notify.gmOnly: Only the GM can do this.
Notify.noGM: A GM must be connected: traps are resolved on the GM’s side.
Notify.noticed: {name} spotted “{trap}”. Players can’t see it yet — decide in chat or with the button on the map.
Notify.otherScene: This trap is on another scene.
Notify.activatorAdded: “{name}”: trigger added. Move it on the map with the teal ✥ handle.
Notify.activatorAddedManual: “{name}”: trigger added, but the trap only fires manually — untick that in its settings.
Notify.activatorFailed: “{name}”: the trigger couldn't be placed — the trap fires from its own area. If you just updated the module, relaunch the world.
Notify.activatorMax: “{name}” already has {n} triggers — that's the limit.
Notify.noRotation: “{name}”: traps don't rotate to arbitrary angles — the ↻ button next to the trap on the map turns it 90°.
Notify.straightened: Trap Library PF2e straightened {n} rotated traps and triggers in place. To turn a trap 90°, use the ↻ button next to it on the map.
Notify.notPf2e: Trap Library PF2e is made for Pathfinder 2e: checks and damage won’t work in another system.
Notify.noRank: {name} isn’t skilled enough: Disable a Device needs {skill} at rank “{rank}”.

trapId.label: Based on
trapId.hint: The built-in or custom trap this one was made from.

icon.label: Icon
icon.hint: Font Awesome icon class, e.g. fa-solid fa-fire.

detectRange.label: Notice from, ft
detectRange.hint: Secret checks and searches reach this far, counted in squares like the ruler: 10 ft means one empty square in between.

attackBonus.label: Attack
attackBonus.hint: If set, the trap attacks against AC instead of forcing a save. A critical hit deals double damage.

damage.label: Damage
damage.hint: A formula such as 2d10. Empty — no damage.

condition.label: Condition
condition.hint: Applied on a failed save or a hit.

sound.label: Sound
sound.hint: A built-in sound or a path to your own file.

flavor.label: Text for players
flavor.hint: Shown to players in chat when the trap goes off.

stops.label: Stops movement
stops.hint: A token that steps in stops there (pit, bear trap, net).

fixedDamage.label: Damage doesn’t grow with level
fixedDamage.hint: For falls and other physical things: damage and the escape DC stay the same at any level. Stealth, disable, save and attack always grow.

escapeDC.label: Escape DC
escapeDC.hint: Escape (Athletics or Acrobatics) or climb out of a pit. 0 — not needed.

manual.label: Manual only
manual.hint: Doesn't fire from footsteps — only from the ▶ button on the map or Set off on the scene tab.

activators.label: Triggers
activators.hint: How many separate areas someone has to step on. With none, the trap's own area sets it off.

level.label: Trap level
level.hint: In the library — for a level 1 party; on the scene — already adjusted to the party level.

detectRank.label: Notice: rank needed
detectRank.hint: With no rank anyone can notice it, even without Searching. With a rank, only a character who is Searching and has at least that Perception rank.

disarmRank.label: Disable: rank needed
disarmRank.hint: Without this rank in the skill you can’t attempt Disable a Device.

disarmSuccesses.label: Successes needed
disarmSuccesses.hint: A critical success counts as two. A critical failure sets the trap off.

damage2Persistent.label: Second damage is persistent
damage2Persistent.hint: Acid, fire, poison, bleed: the system puts it on the target and rolls it at the end of its turn until a DC 15 flat check ends it.

conditionValue.label: Condition value
conditionValue.hint: Frightened 1, sickened 2… One higher on a critical failure.

fxMode.name: Animations
fxMode.hint: Built-in animations always work. If Sequencer and JB2A are installed, their effects can be used instead.

chatMode.name: Who sees the trigger card
chatMode.hint: With “GM only”, the owners of targets still get the card when they need to roll saves.

passiveDetect.name: Secret Perception near traps
passiveDetect.hint: When a player character comes near a trap, the GM secretly rolls their Perception against the trap’s Stealth DC — once per trap. Only the GM sees the result.

detectSight.name: Spot only in line of sight
detectSight.hint: Walls that block sight and closed doors stop a character from spotting a trap — by a secret check or a search.

triggerBy.name: Who sets traps off
triggerBy.hint: Traps can fire on player characters only, so the GM can move monsters freely.

mapButtons.name: Trap buttons on the map
mapButtons.hint: The GM sees an eye button on every trap: one click reveals it to players or hides it. Each GM has their own setting.

detectMode.name: When a character spots a trap
detectMode.hint: What happens when a Perception check (secret on approach, or a search) succeeds. You can also switch this on the On this scene tab.
detectMode.reveal: Reveal it on the map to everyone and whisper the player
detectMode.gm: Tell the GM who spotted it; reveal it to players by hand

saveRolls.name: Who rolls saves against traps
saveRolls.hint: Players: each target in the trigger card has a save button for the character’s owner (the GM gets it too, plus “Roll the rest”). Module: rolls right away. Characters without a player are always rolled by the module.
saveRolls.players: Players roll with a button in the card

damageMode.name: When trap damage is applied
damageMode.hint: On click: the GM sees in the card who takes how much and presses “Apply”. Right away: damage and conditions apply as soon as the check result is known.
damageMode.button: When the GM clicks “Apply” in the card
damageMode.auto: Automatically, once the result is known

updateCheck.name: Tell me about new versions
updateCheck.hint: When the GM enters the world (at most once an hour), the module asks GitHub whether a new version of Trap Library PF2e is out and shows what's new and how to update. Players see nothing.

disarmRolls.name: Who rolls disarm checks
disarmRolls.hint: Player — when the GM clicks the wrench, the character's owner gets a card with a Roll button; the GM's copy has “Roll for the player”. GM — rolled right away. Characters without a player are always rolled by the GM.
disarmRolls.players: The player rolls from a card

playerDisarm.name: Players disarm spotted traps themselves
playerDisarm.hint: A player gets their own wrench next to a trap on the map if they know about it (it's revealed, or the GM told them) and their character stands next to it.
playerDisarm.on: Players have their own wrench on traps they know about
playerDisarm.off: Disarming only through the GM's wrench

searchMode.name: Who can notice a trap on approach
searchMode.hint: Under GM Core, anyone can notice a trap with no rank, but a trap with a rank can only be found by a character who is Searching (Search selected in exploration).
searchMode.activity: By the rules: ranked traps only by Searching characters
searchMode.always: Everyone, as if all were Searching

Device.title: Device
Device.hint: Describe the trap in-world — damage, DCs and conditions update to match.
Device.controlled: Set by the device: changes when you change its settings.

Editor.title: Configure: {name}
Editor.name: Name
Editor.escapeHint: Escape, or climb out of a pit. 0 — not needed.
Editor.tiersTitle: For a party of another level: Stealth and damage
Editor.dragHint: You can drag the card onto the map.
Editor.placeHint: Places it hidden at the center of the view.
Editor.activatorHint: Triggers appear in the trap's area and hit everyone in it. Move them on the map with the teal ✥ handle.
Editor.manualHint: Doesn't fire from footsteps — only from the ▶ button on the map or Set off on the scene tab.
Editor.conditionValueHint: Frightened 1, sickened 2… One higher on a critical failure.

Name.title: Name your trap
Name.label: Name
Name.hint: This is the trap’s name in My traps and on the map.
Name.overHint: This trap was placed from your “{name}”. Update it or save as a new one?

Update.title: Trap Library PF2e: version {version} is out
Update.how: To update: on the Foundry setup screen, Add-on Modules → Check for Updates → update Trap Library PF2e, then relaunch the world.
